SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Shri Krishna Ayush University (SKAU) has released the notification for the Post Of Staff Nurse, Ayurvedic Pharmacist & Clerk. This recruitment has been issued for 60 posts. Online applying process for SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 has started from 30 July 2026 & the candidates can apply till 21 August 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for SKAU Kurukshetra Non Teaching Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 July 2026
  • Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General & Other State : Rs. 1500/-
  • Haryana Reserve Category : Rs. 750/-
  • PwBD Candidate : Rs. 00/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
